parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood with a rectangular box shape.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the door and shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s overall stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a flat MDF panel attached to the frame with hinges, featuring a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board, dividing the storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and organizes stored items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height depending on the design.
